Enterprise Gateway & Integration Services (EGIS III)

This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for informational and planning purposes to support acquisition strategy development for the next-generation Enterprise Gateway & Integration Services (EGIS III) contract. This does not constitute an Invitation for Bids, Request for Proposal, Request for Quotation or obligation on the part of USCIS to issue an RFQ or award a contract.

See the attached document for additional information.
